questions.evidence: and she named him Samuel, saying, “Because I have asked him of Yahweh

To whom did Israel lose the battle in which God's ark was taken?
questions.evidence: The Philistines fought, and Israel was defeated, and each man fled to his tent

questions.q: What did Israel's elders ask Samuel to give them, like all the nations?
questions.evidence: Now make us a king to judge us like all the nations

questions.evidence: When Samuel saw Saul, Yahweh said to him, “Behold, the man of whom I spoke to you

questions.q: Whom did Samuel anoint in the middle of his brothers?
questions.evidence: Then Samuel took the horn of oil, and anointed him in the middle of his brothers. Then Yahweh’s Spirit came mightily on David from that day forward

questions.q: Where was the Philistine champion Goliath from?
questions.evidence: A champion out of the camp of the Philistines named Goliath, of Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span went out

questions.q: Where did David's stone strike Goliath?
questions.evidence: David put his hand in his bag, took a stone, and slung it, and struck the Philistine in his forehead

questions.q: Whose soul was knit with the soul of David?
questions.evidence: When he had finished speaking to Saul, the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul

questions.q: In the cave, what did David secretly cut off from Saul?
questions.evidence: Then David arose, and cut off the skirt of Saul’s robe secretly

questions.q: How did Saul die on Mount Gilboa?
options: He fell on his own sword
questions.evidence: Therefore Saul took his sword, and fell on it
